verses.1: And he sent servants from the king of Tyre to David. They brought with them cedars, timber for building houses, and other kinds of wood that could be used in construction.
verses.2: David knew that Jehovah had prepared him to be king over Israel. He was chosen to rule over his people, Israel.
verses.3: David took more wives in Jerusalem. He had more sons and daughters.
verses.4: And these are the names of the children who were born in Jerusalem: Shmuel, Shuvav, and Shlomo.
verses.6: And it will be broken and destroyed.
verses.8: And the Philistines heard that David had become king over all Israel. So all the Philistines went to ask for David’s hand in marriage. David heard about this and went out to meet them.
verses.9: And the Philistines came and took over the land of Rephaim.
verses.10: And David asked God, “Let me go up against Philistines. Please give them into my hands.” And Jehovah said to him, “Go, and you shall deliver them into your hands.”
verses.11: And they went up to Baal-Perazim. There, David fought against his enemies. David said, “May the Lord defeat my enemies with my own hands, just as water can destroy those who are strong.” Therefore, they named that place Baal-Perazim.
verses.12: And they left their God there. David said, “Burn them with fire.”
verses.13: And they still attacked Philistines, and they were defeated in the wilderness.
verses.14: And David again asked God for help. God said to him, “Do not go after them from above; come to them from below.”
verses.15: And when you hear the sound of their footsteps at the head of the troops, then you shall go into battle, just as God went before you to destroy the camp of the Philistines.
verses.16: David did what God commanded him. He attacked the Philistine camp from Giv’on to Gaza.
verses.17: And David went forth into all the lands, and Jehovah gave him fear to all the nations.
